ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a two-column table, with headers x and f(x). From the table, the readable value pairs include: when x=0, f(x)=2; when x=1, f(x)=5; when x=3, f(x)=6; when x=6, f(x)=7; when x=7, f(x)=5; when x=9, f(x)=4; when x=10, f(x)=1. Then reason: To obtain from the Mean Value Theorem some c such that f'(c)=0, it is necessary to find a closed interval whose two endpoint function values are equal. In the table, f(1)=5 and f(7)=5. The problem states that f is continuous and differentiable on 0<x<10, so on [1,7] it satisfies the conditions of the Mean Value Theorem. Therefore there exists c in (1,7) such that f'(c)=(f(7)-f(1))/(7-1)=(5-5)/6=0. So the required interval is 1<x<7.
